name: com.needle.inference
description: On-device Needle 3 tool calling and Whistle speech-to-text, allocation-free after load. Burst ISystem pumps an unmanaged request/reply channel; typed NPC commands come from the W10 source generator. Designers can add an agent with no code: Model, Tool Set and Agent assets and a Needle Agent component whose tools fire UnityEvents.

samples.description: Plain-language squad orders wired up in the Inspector: a Model, a Tool Set and an Agent asset, the Needle Agent component, and an order box.
Interactive 3D URP arena showcasing Needle 3 tool calling (typed Squad Sink, Smart Camp, Assistant) and Whistle speech-to-text with live telemetry.
Free-form orders for a squad from a text box or voice transcript. Allocation-free on the main thread, no ECS needed.
Burst ISystem pumping the unmanaged channel with typed NPC commands.
Push-to-talk speech to text with Whistle.
